I am writing to express my keen interest in the Social Media Manager position at Meta Endurance, as advertised. My background as a Digital Marketer with a strong focus on content, SEO, and data analysis aligns well with the responsibilities outlined in your job description.

Thank you for your time and consideration. My CV is attached for your review.

cover_letter:
Dear Meta Endurance Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Social Media Manager position at Meta Endurance. As a digital marketer with a comprehensive technical background, I am particularly drawn to your specialization in running, cycling, and triathlon, and eager to apply my expertise to further your mission across key social platforms.

My experience aligns directly with the content production and strategy aspects of this role. I have a proven track record in SEO blog and website content writing, ensuring compliance with established guidelines, and am adept at creating visuals using tools like Canva. My HubSpot Content Marketing Certification further underlines my capability in crafting compelling copy. I am confident in my ability to manage content timelines effectively and to contribute to the consistent implementation of Meta Endurance’s distinct DNA across Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.

Identifying and sharing social media trends is a responsibility I am well-prepared for, drawing on my robust skills in keyword research, on-page SEO, and AEO (AI search visibility). Furthermore, my daily use of AI and LLMs for research and content generation equips me to efficiently discover emerging trends and develop engaging content. My analytical abilities, honed through tracking results with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs, will be instrumental in data gathering, analysis, and contributing to strategic projects.

In previous roles, I have managed content and publishing for client websites, including explicit social media integration, and successfully grown organic traffic. My technical foundation as a Front-End Developer, combined with my digital marketing experience, provides a strong understanding of how to optimize online presence for measurable growth. I am keen to support the Community Manager and collaborate effectively within your team.

I am eager to bring my blend of marketing and technical skills to Meta Endurance and contribute to your continued success in the sports media landscape. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing this opportunity further.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Content creation and copywriting expertise for SEO blogs and websites, including visual production with Canva, reinforced by a HubSpot Content Marketing Certification.
• Strong analytical skills applied to track results with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs, supporting data-driven strategy and reporting.
• Proven ability to identify digital trends and optimize content visibility through in-depth keyword research, on-page SEO, and AI-enhanced search visibility techniques.
• Daily practical application of AI/LLMs for research, efficient content generation, and automation, enhancing workflow and strategic development.
• Experience in managing content timelines and publishing, including social media integration in website projects, complemented by a solid technical background.
